name: corespeed-cli
description: CoreSpeed from Codex through the cs command-line tool: sign in once in the browser, then search for a tool, read its schema, and call it from the shell — long-term memory shared across your agents, the organization's Drive with local files on one end, the tools your organization has enabled on CoreSpeed, and API keys for CI. Registers no MCP server.

interface.longDescription: CoreSpeed gives your organization one place for agent tools: long-term memory shared across agents, a Drive every tool reads and writes, the tools of the apps your organization has enabled, and API keys with spend caps and an audit trail. This plugin brings it to Codex through the cs command-line tool. Sign in once in the browser; after that the agent searches for a tool, reads its schema, and calls it from the shell, uploads and downloads Drive files with cs drive, with every call metered and, where your organization requires it, approved by a human first. It registers no MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Sign me in to CoreSpeed with the cs CLI and tell me which organization I am using.
Find the CoreSpeed tool for this task with cs mcp search, show me its schema, then call it.
Upload this file to my CoreSpeed Drive with cs drive put and share it with the organization.
